title: Gafgyt_Botnet_Investigation_410
description: Investigate a network experiencing unusual traffic patterns and performance degradation due to a Gafgyt botnet infection.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The network has experienced unusual traffic patterns and performance degradation due to a suspected Gafgyt botnet infection. Your task is to investigate and identify the source of these issues.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content:
You have SSH access to the bot1 host with the following credentials:
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano
levels.local_content: Local sandbox access is not required for this scenario.

levels.title: Suspicious Beacon Service Discovery
levels.content: Investigate the bot1 host and identify any unauthorized or suspicious services that might be responsible for periodic external communication.
levels.solution: Check running services and systemd timers for any unusual activity. Look for services related to beaconing behavior associated with botnet activity. The flag is 'bot-beacon.timer'.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check running services and systemd timers for any unusual activity.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for services related to beaconing behavior associated with botnet activity.

levels.title: C2 Communication Discovery (IP Address)
levels.content: Determine the external host that the compromised system is communicating with.
levels.solution: Examine network connections and logs for any suspicious outbound traffic. Look for connections to the command-and-control server. The flag is '192.168.70.5'.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Examine network connections and logs for any suspicious outbound traffic.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for connections to the command-and-control server.

levels.title: Flood Attack Target Identification
levels.content: Identify the system receiving the abnormal volume of network traffic generated by the compromised host.
levels.solution: Review network logs and connections to find the target of the flood attack. The flag is '192.168.80.100'.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Review network logs and connections to find the target of the flood attack.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for connections to the victim system.
